title: Park Up - Car
description:
ONLY UP — BUT YOU'RE DRIVING
Park Up - Car is a short, punishing car-based foddian. Choose a car or motorbike and climb an absurd vertical obstacle course using precise jumps, careful balance and boost.

There are no guardrails and very few second chances. Miss a landing and you may watch minutes of progress disappear below you. Learn the route, control your momentum and keep climbing.

FEATURES

• Jump and boost with cars and motorbikes.

• Climb one continuous route through surreal, colorful worlds.

• Recover from near misses—or fall a very long way.

• Chase faster times and cleaner runs.

• Play on Windows, Linux or Steam Deck Verified hardware.

Made for players who enjoy difficult games, speedruns and the irresistible urge to try one more time.
description_short: Climb an absurd vertical obstacle course in a car or motorbike. Jump, boost and balance across floating roads, traps and impossible turns—but one mistake can send you all the way back down. A short, punishing foddian built for speedruns.
